 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Embrace the perfect harmony of strength and compassion with the Obsidian & Rose Quartz Bracelet. Designed to symbolize the balance of dark and light energies, this bracelet merges the grounding power of Black Obsidian with the gentle, loving aura of Rose Quartz.

Obsidian shields against negativity, clears mental fog, and stabilizes your energy, while Rose Quartz opens the heart to self-love, healing, and emotional balance. Together, they create an energetic synergy that promotes peace, clarity, and emotional resilience — making it the perfect everyday companion for those seeking inner alignment.

 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q. What is Love Protection Bracelet used for?

It is commonly used for love, self-love, emotional healing, relationship harmony, protection, and grounding.

Q. Which crystals are used in this bracelet?

This bracelet is made with Rose Quartz crystal and Black Obsidian crystal.

Q. Can I wear it daily?

Yes, it is suitable for daily wear, self-care, work, travel, meditation, and emotional balance.

Q. Which wrist should I wear it on?

Wear it on the left wrist to receive love, healing, and protective energy.

Q. Who can wear this bracelet?

It is suitable for men and women who want emotional balance, love energy, heart healing, and protection from negativity.
